jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About DMI:

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end\-to\-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost\-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com
About the Opportunity:

DMI is seeking a **Program Manager** to serve as the primary contractor point of contact for a federal agency client, coordinating all tasks, deliverables, and personnel across a multi\-disciplinary IT support Blanket Purchase Agreement. In this role, you will manage delivery execution, stakeholder communication, and risk management across concurrent task orders spanning network engineering, cybersecurity, cloud, and application development.

 **Duties and Responsibilities:*** Serve as the primary liaison between DMI and the government client, reporting program performance and delivery status to the COR and executive leadership on a regular cadence
* Lead project initiation and planning across all active task orders, translating business and technical requirements into implementation plans with defined schedules and milestones
* Manage contractor resources and labor across all task orders, assigning work based on skill and availability while forecasting burn rate and monitoring budget consumption
* Oversee daily execution and deliverable quality, ensuring all submissions meet contractual requirements and client standards before delivery
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks; maintain a risk register and escalate unresolved issues with recommended courses of action
* Prepare and present program status briefings and PMR materials; develop and maintain task proposals, policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures


Qualifications:
**Education and Years of Experience:*** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, or a related field preferred
* 5\+ years of program management experience on federal IT contracts
* US. Citizenship or Permanent Resident status required
* Experience defining requirements and preparing task proposals, including budget and schedule development
* Experience developing policies, procedures, and work instructions
* Experience with project management tools
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience briefing senior government executives
* Working knowledge of IT and cybersecurity capabilities
* PMP certification, or 10\+ years of demonstrated program management experience in lieu of certification

**Required Skills \& Certifications:*** Experience managing BPA or IDIQ task order vehicles in a federal environment
* Proficiency with project management platforms such as Microsoft Project or Jira

**Background Requirements:** Must possess or be eligible to obtain and complete a Public Trust background investigation and/or a Public Trust clearance. **Citizenship Status Required:** Must be a U.S. Citizen **Physical Requirements:** None required for this position. **Location:** Remote, US
Minimum Salary Rate: $149,568 Median Salary Rate: $186,960 Working at DMI:

DMI is a diverse, prosperous, and rewarding place to work. Our culture is shaped by five core values that guide how we work, grow, and succeed together:* **Do What’s Right** – We lead with honesty and integrity.
* **Own the Outcome** – We take responsibility and deliver.
* **Deliver for Our Customers** – We are relentless about delivering value.
* **Think Bold, Act Smart** – We innovate with purpose.
* **Win Together** – We collaborate and celebrate our success.


These values aren’t just ideals—they show up in how we support every part of your well\-being:* **Convenience/Concierge** – Virtual health visits, commuter perks, pet insurance, and entertainment discounts that make life easier.
* **Development** – Annual performance reviews, tuition assistance, and internal career growth opportunities to help you thrive.
* **Financial** – Generous 401(k) matches, life and disability insurance, and financial wellness tools to support your future.
* **Recognition** – Annual awards, service anniversaries, referral bonuses, and peer\-to\-peer shoutouts that spotlight your achievements.
* **Wellness** – Healthcare coverage, wellness programs, flu shots, and biometric screenings to support your health.


DMI values employees for their talents and contributions, and we take pride in helping our customers achieve their goals. Because when we live our values, we all win together. **\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* No Agencies Please \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\***  

Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. US citizenship may be required for some positions.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud & Compliance Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Coalfire**

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever\-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.

But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.

We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem\-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.  

**Position Summary**

The Advisory Senior Project Manager is a senior, client\-facing delivery leader responsible for planning, governing, and delivering complex consulting engagements from initiation through closeout. The role serves as the primary project management partner to clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams, translating engagement objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.



Working across Coalfire’s Cloud, Compliance Advisory, Cloud Maintenance \& Operations, and related consulting practices, the Senior Project Manager establishes delivery structure and manages scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and client commitments.



This role requires strong consulting presence, sound business judgment, executive communication, and the ability to operate independently in a matrixed environment. The Senior Project Manager leads through influence, brings transparency to delivery, and protects both the client experience and Coalfire’s delivery standards.



### **What You'll Do**



**CLIENT \& ENGAGEMENT LEADERSHIP**



* Serve as the primary project management point of contact for clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams throughout the engagement.
* Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication, credible advice, reliable follow\-through, and a strong understanding of client objectives.
* Lead project initiation, discovery, kickoff, planning, execution, transition, and closeout activities for consulting engagements.
* Translate statements of work, engagement objectives, and client requirements into clear delivery plans, milestones, outcomes, and acceptance criteria.
* Set expectations regarding scope, schedule, budget, roles, decision rights, deliverables, assumptions, and escalation paths.
* Anticipate client needs and delivery risks, surface concerns early, and recommend practical options that support successful outcomes.
**PROJECT DELIVERY \& CONTROLS**



* Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent client engagements, from initiation through delivery, transition, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans with appropriate detail to manage milestones, workstreams, dependencies, resources, deliverables, and critical path activities.
* Establish and maintain baselines for scope, schedule, budget, resources, and delivery milestones; assess and communicate variance.
* Coordinate work across matrixed consulting, technical, operational, and client teams to maintain delivery velocity and alignment.
* Define deliverable ownership, review cycles, acceptance criteria, and completion evidence; drive timely client approvals and sign\-offs.
* Manage scope and change control, including impact analysis, approvals, documentation, and communication of approved changes.
* Track project health using meaningful delivery metrics and provide clear recommendations when intervention or recovery planning is required.
* Ensure project documentation, decisions, action items, approvals, and status artifacts are complete, accurate, and maintained throughout the engagement.
**GOVERNANCE, RISK \& QUALITY MANAGEMENT**



* Design and manage an engagement governance model appropriate to the project’s size, complexity, client environment, and risk profile.
* Establish meeting cadences, forums, decision rights, escalation paths, reporting expectations, and stakeholder participation across the engagement.
* Maintain the RAID log and actively manage risks, assumptions, issues, decisions, dependencies, constraints, and mitigations through resolution.
* Lead governance reviews, stage gates, steering committee meetings, executive updates, and other formal delivery checkpoints.
* Prepare concise governance packs that communicate overall health, progress, decisions needed, risks, issues, financial status, and recommended actions.
* Escalate matters with sufficient context, impact analysis, options, and a recommended path forward; follow through until resolution or formal acceptance.
* Apply Coalfire delivery methodology, quality standards, and required controls; identify and address gaps before they affect client outcomes.
* Ensure engagements are delivered in accordance with applicable contractual commitments, internal policies, security expectations, and quality requirements.
**FINANCIAL \& COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT**



* Monitor project budgets, forecasts, burn, actuals, remaining effort, resource plans, and financial performance throughout the engagement.
* Partner with engagement and practice leadership to identify financial risks, forecast changes, and recovery actions.
* Track scope alignment and potential scope leakage; coordinate change requests and commercial impacts with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support accurate time, expense, invoicing, utilization, and revenue\-related processes in accordance with Coalfire requirements.
* Maintain visibility into resource capacity, staffing needs, delivery constraints, and planned transitions across the project lifecycle.
**STAKEHOLDER \& EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION**



* Provide clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate status reporting for clients, project teams, sponsors, practice leaders, and executives.
* Lead client status meetings, working sessions, steering committees, executive briefings, retrospectives

**About Slater Certified®**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce.


Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi.


The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process.


**Position summary**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. We are selling and building at the same time, with a small team and a lot of moving parts: prospects in conversation, clients being onboarded, courses in development, and commitments made in a sales meeting that engineering then has to deliver.


We are hiring a Project Manager on a contract basis to be the bridge between sales and delivery. You hold the single picture of where everything stands \- who is in the pipeline, who is in flight and how far along they are, what we can sell today, what is coming and when, and what each of those depends on. When sales asks whether we can commit to a date, you are the person who knows.


You will work directly with the VP of Sales, the CTBO and the engineering team, keeping logistics and pipeline moving. It is part project manager, part coordinator, part meeting facilitator \- hands\-on, no direct reports, and a lot of detail that nobody else is going to pick up. If it works on both sides, there is a path to converting it to a full\-time position.


**What this role owns in the first six months**

* One view of the pipeline and delivery that sales, engineering and leadership all use and all trust \- not three spreadsheets that disagree.
* The existing pipeline, built up so far by our business development lead, has been taken over and turned into something that runs as a system rather than living in one person's head.
* Every client in flight has a plan, a timeline, a named status and a next action, current enough that nobody has to ask.
* A standing, accurate answer to “what can we sell today, what is coming, and when” \- so sales stops guessing and engineering stops being surprised.
* Status reporting that leadership reads instead of requesting.
* Meetings that end with decisions and owners rather than another meeting.

**Key responsibilities**

**Bridging sales and delivery**


* Sit between the VP of Sales, the CTBO and engineering, and keep all three working from the same picture.
* Translate what sales is promising into what engineering has to build, and flag the gap before a commitment is made rather than after.
* Maintain what is sellable today versus what is on the roadmap, and keep that honest.
* Chase the dependencies between the two sides \- the content, the configuration, the approval, the answer from a customer \- so nothing stalls quietly.

**Pipeline and clients in flight**


* Take handover of the pipeline as it stands today from business development, and make it current, complete and usable by everyone who needs it.
* Track prospects through the pipeline: where each one stands, what it is waiting on, what it would take to close.
* Run onboarding for clients in flight end to end, from kickoff to go\-live.
* Keep the CRM and the delivery plan reflecting the same reality.
* Be the point of contact who knows the status, and who tells a client before they have to ask.

**Delivery with engineering**


* Own the Jira board: hygiene, flow, and whether it still describes how work actually moves.
* Turn requirements into tickets with clear scope and acceptance criteria, and push back when a requirement is not ready.
* Run the cadence \- planning, standups, retrospectives \- at whatever weight a small team can sustain without ceremony for its own sake.
* Track work through the release path into TEST and on to production, and make sure nothing sits in a column because nobody noticed.

**Meetings, status and reporting**


* Facilitate the meetings: set the agenda, hold the time, and leave with decisions and owners written down.
* Produce status reporting an executive can read in two minutes and an engineer can trust.
* Identify risks early, escalate with a recommendation rather than a question, and manage scope changes including the schedule consequence.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Program Manager, Global Technical Enablement
jobs.description:
### **Remote \- USA \| GTM Excellence**


Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest\-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world\-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI\-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.


Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, chief of staff roles, or technical program management, including direct support of senior leaders.
* Proven experience managing operational tech stacks, vendor relationships, and tracking organizational budgets/OPEX or business cases.
* Demonstrated ability to write and speak at a leadership altitude, holding the room and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders without formal direct authority.
* Exceptional ability to manage multiple complex threads, ensuring nothing is dropped, everything is documented, and decisions result in action.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience in an Office\-of\-the\-CxO or serving as a dedicated right\-hand to a senior leader in a high\-tech environment.
* Familiarity with cloud concepts (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure), cybersecurity, technical lab environments, or developer platforms.
* Experience working inside or directly partnering with technical enablement, customer engineering, sales engineering, or customer success organizations.
* Thrives in high ambiguity, capable of inventing structure when priorities shift rapidly across a distributed, global organization.

**About the Job:**


As the Strategy \& Operations Program Manager for Global Technical Enablement (GTE), you will serve as the operational right hand and proxy to the Head of GTE. This is not a general program\-management role; your mandate is to build the operating system that runs the organization and keep the business inspection\-ready at all times.


You will not have direct reports; instead, your influence and operational rigor will ensure that critical multi\-team programs move smoothly from ideation to delivery. You will sit with the Head, be in the room for the decisions, carry their proxy, and govern the organization's technological, financial, and strategic resources. Ultimately, you will own the living story of the business, the cadence, the data narrative, and the cross\-cutting initiatives that belong to no single team; ensuring leadership can speak to status, strategy, and risk at a moment's notice.


Wiz’s Global Technical Enablement (GTE) team is the end\-to\-end owner of technical product mastery. We build and execute role\-based onboarding, interactive learning journeys, and hands\-on lab environments that enable our technical field teams and customers to position, deploy, and optimize complex cloud solutions at scale. Operating across 8 time zones and 6 countries, we pride ourselves on dependability, radical collaboration, and continuous innovation.


To ensure the strategic value of this role is maintained, please note that it is explicitly:


* Not a layer between the Head and the four team leaders, their direct line is unchanged.
* Not the owner of team execution: Architecture, TLDD, Experiences, and TEDO run their own work.
* Not an Executive Assistant: no calendar, travel, or expense ownership.

**Responsibilities:**


* Own the Operating Rhythm: Architect and facilitate leadership staff meetings, strategic quarterly planning, and retrospective sessions across the four GTE pillars to ensure tight cross\-team alignment.
* Drive the OKR Lifecycle: Partner with leadership to draft, cascade, and track OKRs, proactively mitigating schedule risks before they impact the business.
* Govern the Decision Log: Ensure that nothing agreed upon leaves the room without an owner and a date, and follow through so that initiatives don't stall or quietly die after kickoff.
* Build the Case (Tech Spend \& Forecasting): Lead financial forecasting, budget tracking, and business case development specifically for the organization’s enablement infrastructure (lab environments, software licensing, tool subscriptions, and vendor platforms).
* Vendor \& Platform Lifecycle: Oversee the end\-to\-end renewals of GTE platforms, manage vendor relationships, and optimize the operational tech stack.
* Access \& Tech Governance: Manage the integration, provisioning, and access logistics for the org's internal and external enablement platforms, ensuring seamless workflows and security compliance.
* Own the "Walking Deck": Maintain a continuously current narrative of the business (org, strategy, OKR status, metrics, risks, and wins) that is ready to present with zero prep.
* Turn Data into Narrative: Partner with analysts to convert central dashboards, learner throughput, and course CSAT into the actionable story leadership needs.
* Anticipate the Inspection: Prepare the Head

jobs.title: Fraud Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the Business**
**LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing fraud detection. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. Our innovative solutions enable our clients to manage risks like identity theft, fraud, money laundering and terrorism, and prevent financial crimes. Our core mission is to ultimately help make communities safer and to protect those who may be vulnerable to fraud. Drawing from the collective expertise of our experienced team, we continuously evolve to stay a step ahead of fraudsters. Every day, as millions go about their lives, it's our behind\-the\-scenes efforts that ensure their security, giving them the confidence to trust and engage online without fear of being de\-frauded.**

**About the Team**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


LexisNexis® Risk Solutions helps organizations make better decisions by leveraging data, advanced analytics, and technology to evaluate and predict risk, detect fraud, and combat financial crime. Our solutions empower customers across banking, financial services, and e\-commerce to address challenges such as identity theft, account takeover, money laundering, social engineering, and other emerging fraud threats.


Our Fraud and Identity Professional Services team works directly with leading financial institutions and global organizations to optimize fraud prevention strategies and maximize the value of LexisNexis Risk Solutions products. We are a collaborative team of consultants, analysts, and subject matter experts who combine technical expertise, data\-driven insights, and industry knowledge to help clients reduce risk, improve customer experiences, and stay ahead of evolving fraud trends.

  

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The Fraud Data Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and analytical consultant, supporting large banking, financial services, and e\-commerce clients in the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of fraud and identity solutions. This role blends data analytics, fraud investigation, technical consulting, and client engagement.


The ideal candidate is highly analytical, customer\-focused, and passionate about solving complex fraud and risk challenges. You will work closely with clients to assess fraud patterns, analyze performance data, develop detection strategies, and provide actionable recommendations that improve fraud prevention outcomes while minimizing friction for legitimate customers.

  

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Review suspicious activity, fraud alerts, and complex fraud cases to identify emerging risks, trends, and vulnerabilities.
* Analyze large datasets to build, optimize, and maintain fraud detection rules, models, and workflows that improve fraud prevention and operational efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analyses to investigate client issues, identify contributing factors, and develop effective solutions.
* Deliver impactful analyses and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders through presentations, reports, and client consultations.
* Advise clients on best practices for implementing and optimizing ThreatMetrix® Digital Identity Network, Digital Device Profiling (DDP), and other LexisNexis Risk Solutions products.
* Partner with clients to improve fraud mitigation strategies while balancing customer experience and operational objectives.
* Perform proof\-of\-concept analyses and demonstrate measurable business value through data\-driven insights.
* Collaborate closely with fraud managers, risk analysts, developers, project managers, and other customer stakeholders to support solution adoption and performance optimization.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by serving as a trusted consultant and subject matter expert.
* Develop reports, dashboards, and analytical deliverables using SQL, Excel, Python, R, and other analytics tools.
* Research emerging fraud techniques, cybersecurity trends, and financial crime risks to provide proactive recommendations.
* Support internal teams with product feedback, solution enhancements, and client\-related insights.
  

  

**Requirements**
----------------


Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical, analytical, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting customer\-facing technology, analytics, or fraud prevention solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience working within financial services, banking, fintech, payments, risk management, or e\-commerce environments.
* 3\+ years of experience performing advanced analytics using Python (including pandas, scikit\-learn, and matplotlib), R, or similar analytical tools.
* Strong proficiency with SQL and Excel for data analysis, reporting, and performance monitoring.
* Experience investigating fraud, financial crimes, or suspicious activity, including account takeover, card\-not\-present fraud, money laundering, and social engineering attacks.
* Demonstrated ability to perform root

jobs.title: Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Security \- US \- Remote, New York City, Seattle, Washington, DC, and San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, supporting employees’ velocity, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.


Security at OpenAI is a cross\-cutting organization that includes Security, Privacy, IT, GRC, Corporate Security, and other teams. Program Managers play a critical role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale.


**About the Role**


We’re seeking a Program Manager to build and own programs that span OpenAI’s Security organization, with a core focus on Mergers \& Acquisitions. You will work across domains from diligence through Day 1 readiness, integration, onboarding, and transition to ongoing ownership. You will also apply what you build to other priorities that span Security teams. You will learn how work actually moves between teams, spot gaps and unclear ownership, and build practical systems that make complex transitions easier to execute.


This role is deeply cross\-functional and execution\-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguityation and consequential decisions.


**In this role, you will:**


* Own Security \& IT M\&A programsing timely diligence assessments, and scoping, planning, and executing acquisition integrations. Carry the work through Day 1 readiness, onboarding of people and systems, post\-close priorities, and handoff to ongoing owners.
* Partner with Corporate Development, IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, Security, GRC, Corporate Security and other teams to understand cross\-functional requirements and navigate tradeoffs. Make responsibilities and decision rights clear while bringing in the right experts for technical and risk judgments.
* Learn partner teams’ workflows and identify missed dependencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, and risks that could slow an integration or weaken its outcome. Address recurring problems at their source.
* Establish scalable frameworks and processes to support core programs, including defining durable program goals and core measures of success. Build useful intake paths, playbooks, onboarding checklists, decision points, and handoff standards that teams adopt in practice.
* Use AI and automation to organize informationation and human review of risk decisions.
* Create and maintain program\-level visibility across deals, risks, milestones, and dependencies, ensuring program outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality. Measure whether the work improves readiness, reduces manual effort, closes risks, and makes future transitions more predictable.
* Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and executive audiences and drive cross\-functional execution with urgency and care.
* Own additional programs that span Security and IT as organizational priorities evolve, applying and improving the systems built through the M\&A portfolio.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Are an empathetic communicator and leader who is able to influence a variety of cross\-functional and executive audiences, and build durable trust with partners.
* Have 5\+ years of experience leading complex cross\-functional programs, with a proven record of successful partnership in security, IT, infrastructure, privacy, trust, product risk, or other technical domains.
* Have carried programs from an ambiguous starting point through execution and lasting ownership.
* Have built a new program, workflow, or operating model yourself and can show how you earned adoption and improved results.
* Are curious about how teams work in practice and can find the underlying issue behind a missed handoff or recurring exception.
* Have used AI or automation to improve a real workflow and can explain what changed, how people adopted it, and where human judgment remains necessary.
* Have experience in Mergers \& Acquisitions or related areas.
* Thrive in high\-trust environments, bring rigor and systems thinking to ambiguity, and operate with a bias for aligned execution over org boundaries.
* Are structured, detail\-oriented, and rigorous in ensuring quality, accountability, and durable delivery.

**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.


We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

  


Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations.


To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

  


At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.


**Compensation**


$129\.6K – $310K \+ Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

jobs.description:
#### **Who We Are**


Xtensys is a rapidly growing managed service provider delivering innovative technology solutions to health systems, beginning in New York and expanding nationwide. Owned by two industry leaders with a strong focus on advancing rural and community healthcare, Xtensys is executing several major initiatives and scaling quickly. With a team of more than 500 professionals, we are building a people\-centered culture rooted in collaboration, innovation, and strategic thinking.



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives to lead cross\-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Initiatives, this position partners with technology, clinical, operational, business, and other stakeholders to plan and execute projects that advance organizational priorities.



Projects will vary based on organizational priorities and may include healthcare technology implementations, enterprise applications, system integrations, clinical and business systems, operational and process improvements, cybersecurity and risk initiatives, vendor implementations, and other strategic or cross\-functional projects assigned. The role also performs business analysis activities, including requirements gathering, workflow and process documentation, and translating business objectives into actionable project plans.


#### **How We Work:**

* East Coast Alignment: Our core operational and collaboration hours follow the Eastern Time Zone (ET), keeping our workflows synchronized with our primary clients and systems.

* MissionDriven Work: You are the "bridge" ensuring technology serves health systems and their patients when they need it most.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: We trust you. You’ll lead projects, define success, and manage complexities with total support.
* A Culture of Innovation: Have a fresh perspective? We want it. We encourage risktaking and continuous improvement.
* Continuous Growth: We fuel your "restless curiosity" with opportunities to expand your skillset and mentor others.


The Role: This is an experienced\-level project management position requiring a current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and demonstrated success managing projects within healthcare IT or healthcare technology environments. The Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, independently manages assigned projects from initiation through implementation and closeout while exercising sound judgment regarding risks, priorities, stakeholder needs, and issues requiring escalation.


#### **Work Arrangement:**

* Work arrangement will be based on business needs and the requirements of assigned projects. The role requires effective collaboration with geographically distributed teams and availability during established business hours and projectrelated meetings.

#### **Your Mission: What You’ll Do Day\-to\-Day:**

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, implementation, and closeout.
* Partner with project sponsors and stakeholders to define objectives, scope, requirements, deliverables, timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and measures of success.
* Develop and maintain project charters, project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, communication plans, risk and issue logs, decision logs, status reports, and other project documentation as appropriate.

* Track project scope, schedule, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, action items, and, when applicable, budget; identify deviations and coordinate corrective action.
* Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and resource challenges; escalate concerns appropriately when leadership decisions or support are required.
* Manage changes to project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables using established project governance and changecontrol practices.
* Develop and execute project communication plans and provide timely, accurate status updates to project sponsors, stakeholders, and leadership.
* Schedule and facilitate project meetings, working sessions, status reviews, and decision forums that result in clear actions, owners, and accountability.
* Build effective working relationships across departments and lead through coordination and influence in a matrixed environment.
* Coordinate activities with thirdparty vendors, consultants, and implementation partners; track commitments, dependencies, deliverables, and performance.
* Support project implementation, transition, closeout, and lessonslearned activities and identify opportunities to improve project delivery practices.
* Support the Director of Strategic Initiatives with organizational priorities, special projects, and crossfunctional initiatives as assigned.


Who You Are \& What You’ll Bring


* 35 years of progressively responsible project management experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing complex, crossfunctional IT or technologyenabled projects.
* Demonstrated project management experience within healthcare IT, healthcare technology, a health system, or a similarly complex healthcare environment.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple technical, clinical, operational, business, and/or vendor stakeholder groups.
* Experience with project planning, requirements gathering, process and workflow documentation, risk and issue management, change control, stakeholder management, and status reporting

You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure that projects are executed efficiently, on time, and within scope and budget. This role requires strong project management skills, knowledge of cybersecurity, and excellent communication abilities.

**Responsibilities**


Project Planning and Initiation:* Collaborate with clients and internal teams to define project objectives, scope, and requirements.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.
* Identify and allocate resources required for project execution.
* Conduct project kickoff meetings and communicate project goals to the team.


Project Execution and Monitoring:* Lead project teams in executing cybersecurity projects.
* Monitor project progress and track key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Identify and mitigate project risks and issues.
* Ensure that project deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations.


Stakeholder Communication:* Maintain clear and regular communication with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
* Provide project status updates, reports, and documentation as needed.
* Manage client expectations and address concerns promptly.


Resource Management:* Coordinate and allocate resources, including personnel, tools, and equipment.
* Manage project budgets and ensure adherence to financial constraints.


Quality Assurance:* Ensure that all project activities comply with cybersecurity industry standards and best practices.
* Perform quality control and assurance checks on project deliverables.


Change Management:* Partner with business stakeholders to document change requests that impact project scope, budget utilization, and/or resourcing
* Effectively manage project scope changes and assess their impact on timelines and budgets.
* Ensure that change requests are documented and approved by relevant stakeholders.


Project Closure:* Conduct post\-project evaluation and gather lessons learned.
* Prepare and deliver project closure reports to clients and management.

**Technical Knowledge \& Project Delivery**

* Develop a working understanding of Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR) services, including security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response workflows.
* Understand how security telemetry and log sources are collected, ingested, and monitored within a Security Operations Center (SOC) environment.
* Partner closely with Security Engineering teams to identify onboarding prerequisites, validate data collection methods, and prioritize high\-value security telemetry.
* Facilitate discussions with clients regarding scope, timelines, technical dependencies, and onboarding requirements to ensure successful project delivery.
* Support planning and coordination of security tool integrations, including understanding licensing, configuration, and infrastructure requirements that may impact implementation.
* Assist in evaluating and prioritizing security data sources based on business objectives, visibility requirements, and threat detection value.
* Serve as a liaison between clients and technical teams, translating complex security concepts into clear business language.
* Manage projects in a dynamic environment where priorities, scope, and timelines may evolve based on technical findings and client needs.
* Maintain alignment across clients, Project Management, and Security Engineering teams throughout implementation to ensure successful onboarding and acceptance.
* Measure project success through the successful deployment, validation, and operationalization of agreed\-upon security telemetry and monitoring capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in project management, with a focus on IT or cybersecurity projects.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Energy Data Analyst I**

**Northern Wasco County PUD \| The Dalles, Oregon**

**Why Northern Wasco County PUD?**


Join a public utility recognized as one of **The Oregonian’s 2025 Top Workplaces**. Northern Wasco County PUD offers an exceptional benefits package, including **100% employer\-paid medical, prescription, dental, and vision premiums for employees and their families**, plus a **7\.5% base employer 401(k) contribution and up to an additional 7\.5% employer match**.


Beyond the benefits, this is an opportunity to apply advanced data and analytics skills to work that directly supports electric power operations and the communities Northern Wasco County PUD serves.

**Mostly Remote Work:** This position offers a primarily remote work arrangement, with occasional travel to the Northern Wasco County PUD office in **The Dalles, Oregon** for meetings, projects, or other business needs. Candidates should be able and willing to travel to the office when required.

**About the Role**


Northern Wasco County PUD is seeking an **Energy Data Analyst I** to join its Power Resources team. This is a hands\-on technical role combining **complex SQL, Python, relational databases, ETL/data pipelines, and business intelligence** with energy supply and power market analytics.


You’ll develop and maintain the databases, software, automated pipelines, integrations, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support critical Power Resources data and decision\-making. You'll also work with large time\-series datasets involving electric load and resources, power market analytics, energy settlements, reconciliation, and operational reporting.

**Previous electric utility or energy industry experience is preferred but not required.** Candidates with strong technical data analytics experience from other industries are encouraged to apply.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and data models.
* Develop and maintain relational databases, including schemas, tables, functions, and views.
* Design, build, schedule, and maintain ETL processes and around\-the\-clock automated data pipelines.
* Troubleshoot data quality, availability, integration, and performance issues.
* Develop and maintain software, APIs, integrations, and reporting tools supporting critical Power Resources data.
* Analyze electric load and resource data across hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and annual time periods.
* Provide power market analytics and monitoring to support operations, planning, and decision\-making.
* Organize, validate, and analyze data used for energy settlements with counterparties and reconciliation reporting.
* Create dashboards, visualizations, KPI reports, and recurring and ad\-hoc reporting.
* Perform statistical modeling and analysis of structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends and meaningful insights.
* Work with large time\-series datasets collected from internal and external sources.
* Partner with end users to understand business needs, document technical requirements, and develop effective data and reporting solutions.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives focused on improving systems, workflows, controls, and reporting.
* Provide cross\-training and backup support for other Power Resources analytics functions.


Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required to support emergency restoration activities, critical operational needs, or special projects.

**Required Technical Skills**


We're looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in the following areas:

* **Complex SQL query development and optimization**
* **Relational database management systems (RDBMS)**, including schemas, tables, functions, and views
* **ETL tools and automated data pipelines**, including building, scheduling, maintaining, and refining pipelines
* **Python and object\-oriented programming**
* **Git/GitHub or comparable version control**
* **Windows and Linux environments**
* **Business Intelligence and data visualization**
* **Microsoft Excel**
* Microsoft Office applications

**Applicants should expect a technical assessment covering the core required skills during the interview process.**

**Preferred Experience \& Technologies**


Experience with any of the following will help you stand out:

* PostgreSQL / pgAdmin
* Grafana
* R / RStudio
* Java
* AWS, cloud computing, and cloud storage
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Electronic document and records management systems (EDRMS)
* Electric utility or broader energy industry experience
* Power or energy market analytics
* Electric load and resource data
* Energy settlements and reconciliations
* SCADA
* Energy or financial reporting systems
* Large time\-series datasets

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physical Science, Natural Science**, or a related technical or quantitative field.
* **3–5 years of full\-time professional experience** as a Data Analyst or in a similar technical data role with experience across the required technical skill areas.
* An advanced degree in a related field is preferred but not required.
* Other combinations of education and relevant experience demonstrating the required knowledge, skills, and abilities may also be considered.

**Benefits**


Northern Wasco County PUD offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees and their families, including:

* **100% employer\-paid Medical/Rx/Dental premiums** for individual and/or family coverage
* **100% employer\-paid Vision premiums** for individual and/or family coverage
* **401(k): 7\.5% base employer contribution \+ up to a 7\.5% employer match**
* 457(b) retirement plan
* Generous PTO accrual
* 11 paid holidays
* Employer\-paid basic life insurance equal to 2x annual salary
* 100% employer\-paid short\-term disability
* 100%

* Strong knowledge of healthcare enrollment, medical claims, and drug claims data.

**AristaMD**  

**Data \& Analytics**  

**Job Title** Business Data Analyst / Senior Business Intelligence Analyst  

**Classification** Exempt  

**Reports To** CIO/CTO  

**Schedule** Full\-Time \| Remote  


**Who We Are**


AristaMD is the premier virtual\-first professional medical corporation providing specialty care. We enable risk\-bearing PCPs to improve access to specialty care, enhance clinical outcomes, and reduce the total cost of care.  

Our program, SC360, provides point\-of\-care referral decision support, routing every referral by clinical appropriateness to one of three tracks: an eConsult, a virtual specialty care visit, or a curated in\-person specialty network. This ensures every patient gets the right care, at the right time, through the right channel.**Position Summary**


We're looking for a highly technical and consultative Business Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team. This person will own analytics platform governance, lead the ongoing migration of our reporting infrastructure to Power BI, and serve as a strategic partner to clinical, operations, and leadership teams across a fast\-growing healthcare technology company.  

  

This is not a “build the report and move on” role. We're looking for someone who proactively automates repetitive workflows, designs scalable data solutions, and helps teams build the right thing, not just whatever was asked for last. You'll operate inside a mature, enterprise\-scale Power BI environment supporting multiple business lines and client\-facing reporting programs.  

  

You'll join a team that's actively investing in modern analytics infrastructure and AI\-assisted workflows, with the autonomy to shape how the organization measures, automates, and scales its reporting practices. This role has a clear growth path from report development into analytics strategy leadership.  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Analytics Platform Governance*** **Power BI Migration:** Own the migration of legacy reporting tools to Power BI.
* **Certified Reporting Environments:** Establish and maintain certified, well\-documented, and supportable reporting environments that the whole organization can trust.
* **Reporting Asset Ownership:** Act as the primary owner of key reporting assets and dashboards, accountable for their ongoing accuracy, performance, and upkeep.

**2\. Strategic Project Leadership*** **Data Initiatives:** Lead high\-impact data initiatives from discovery through implementation, including compensation and payment data portals, claims and utilization analysis, and enterprise data warehousing work.
* **Requirements \& Acceptance:** Define metric definitions, business rules, UAT processes, and acceptance criteria, and see projects through to production.

**3\. Operational Automation*** **Workflow Automation:** Proactively identify repetitive, manual reporting processes and automate them, turning multi\-hour manual processes into reliable automated pipelines.
* **AI \& Scripting:** Use AI tools and scripting (e.g., workflow automation platforms, scripting languages) to streamline recurring report distribution and internal data workflows.
* **Standardized Reporting Packages:** Develop standardized, reusable reporting packages and automate their recurring distribution to stakeholders and clients, for both internal and external reports.

**4\. Consultative Problem Solving*** **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner directly with business stakeholders across clinical, customer experience, and operations functions.
* **Requirements Translation:** Translate ambiguous business needs into clear analytical requirements and guide teams toward durable solutions rather than one\-off fixes.

**5\. Data Architecture \& Documentation*** **Documentation:** Build and maintain documentation including data dictionaries, reporting standards, and workflow diagrams.
* **Data Warehouse Scalability:** Help ensure the integrity and scalability of an enterprise data warehouse as the organization grows.

**6\. Data Quality \& Integration*** **Data Validation:** Monitor data quality and perform validation checks across reporting layers to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* **Integration Troubleshooting:** Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues between source systems, ETL pipelines, and the data warehouse.

**Required*** Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field
* Expert\-level proficiency in Power BI (including DAX); strong working knowledge of Tableau or similar legacy BI tools

* Proven experience designing and managing ETL pipelines in a modern data warehouse environment (e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
* Experience integrating AI models into analytical or coding workflows, and automating routine business processes

If you enjoy working with data, solving business problems, and turning analysis into practical improvements, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to meaningful projects while collaborating with teams across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
The mission of the ***New Jersey Chapter, American Academy of Pediatrics (NJAAP)*** is the attainment of optimal health, safety, and well\-being of New Jersey’s children (infants, children, adolescents, young adults). In support of this mission, the Chapter also provides a wide range of programs and continuing education opportunities designed to equip pediatric professionals with the knowledge and tools needed to deliver exceptional care. Our educational and quality improvement programs for pediatric providers aim to prevent illness, abuse, and neglect, and promote wellness and care management for children.

**Job Summary**

The **Senior Program Manager** is a member of the NJAAP team assigned to one or more grant\-funded initiatives. Working under the direction of chapter leadership, this role provides high\-level program management, partner and practice engagement, quality improvement support, data coordination, educational planning, and grant reporting support to ensure timely completion of program deliverables and alignment with funder requirements, organizational priorities, and NJAAP’s mission.

The Senior Program Manager exercises independent judgment and discretion, may supervise or support the work of program staff and consultants, and may represent NJAAP externally with practices, partners, coalitions, and other stakeholders. This is an exempt position.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Organization \& Team Engagement**

* Participate in NJAAP team meetings and agency functions as a member of the NJAAP team.
* Collaborate closely with chapter leadership, program staff, consultants, and external partners to support program goals, timelines, and deliverables.
* Represent NJAAP professionally with healthcare professionals, community partners, funders, coalitions, and other stakeholders, as assigned.
* Provide guidance and support to program team members to promote coordination, consistency, and timely completion of assigned work.

**Program Leadership \& Practice Engagement**

* Serve as a primary liaison to participating practices and program partners to support implementation of grant\-funded initiatives.
* Coordinate and monitor completion of contracted deliverables, including practice engagement, data collection, educational participation, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee or support onboarding of participating practices, including coordination of orientation activities, technical assistance, and implementation support.
* Provide quality improvement support to participating practices, including coaching coordination, documentation of practice progress, and participation in practice\-level technical assistance activities.
* Maintain accurate records related to participating practices, clinicians, implementation status, deliverables, and other program tracking needs.
* Support ongoing communication with practices and partners to identify needs, address barriers, and promote successful program participation.
* Support coordination with the Medical Director/Co\-Principal Investigator and other project partners as needed for program oversight, planning, sustainability, replication, and required submissions.

**Education \& Learning Activities**

* Coordinate and co\-facilitate learning collaboratives, communities of practice, trainings, and other educational activities.
* Collaborate with faculty, speakers, consultants, and staff to support planning, communication, and delivery of educational programming.
* Support continuing education planning, applications, and documentation.
* Support alignment between practice\-focused learning activities and broader statewide educational training efforts.

**Data, Evaluation \& Reporting**

* Oversee routine data collection and review program performance metrics.
* Maintain evaluation tools and program tracking systems.
* Reconcile program records on a routine basis to support funder, grant, and internal reporting requirements.
* Generate and interpret data reports to support program improvement and grant requirements.
* Co\-lead preparation of program reports, including monthly, quarterly, and funder\-required reports.

**Partnerships \& External Representation**

* Represent NJAAP in coalition meetings, committees, partner meetings, and technical assistance activities.
* Lead or support follow\-up activities related to coalition participation, partner engagement, billing technical assistance, and practice support.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with healthcare professionals, community organizations, and other stakeholders.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other duties as assigned to support program and organizational priorities.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* Demonstration of highly professional interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally with staff, pediatric clinicians, healthcare professionals, partners, consultants, and stakeholders.
* Ability to represent NJAAP professionally in public, professional, and coalition settings.
* Knowledge of program planning, implementation, evaluation, and reporting.
* Knowledge of quality improvement approaches and ability to support practice\-level implementation activities.
* Ability to interpret program data and use findings to support implementation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and partner relationships.
* Ability to establish priorities, anticipate program needs, work independently, meet deadlines, and proceed with objectives autonomously.
* Willingness to stretch existing skills, take initiative in developing higher\-level program management competencies, and assume increasing responsibility as program and organizational needs evolve.
* Ability to work as a contributing member of interdisciplinary program and organizational teams.
* Ability to coordinate schedules and meetings using platforms such as Microsoft Outlo

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Broadcast Media
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
  
  

**Travel:**  

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employee will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. 10% remote travel is not unusual.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early\-career professional looking to gain hands\-on experience in project management while contributing to strategic technology initiatives that support patient care, operational excellence, and innovation within a nationally recognized healthcare organization. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional looking to develop project management skills while contributing to large\-scale healthcare technology programs.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned technical program leader who thrives in customer\-facing environments, can translate complex technical initiatives into structured delivery plans, and has a proven track record of successfully leading enterprise AI, infrastructure, and transformation programs.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Alpha Engine Strategist Group
jobs.description:
**About Bridgewater**



Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors.



Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting\-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles.



Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment to excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture.

  


**Our Culture**



Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision\-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self\-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300\+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re\-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else.

  


**About Your Role**



The mission of the Alpha Engine Strategist Group is to maintain a resilient and profitable Pure Alpha at scale by managing clients and prospects to desired commercial outcomes. The driving force behind this mission is our Strategist Ecosystem, the distributed leadership model through which we define what needs to happen at every level of our org such that we are engaging the right clients on the right priorities with the right people and the right content and ensuring quality holds throughout.



This role is the dedicated owner of the Strategist Ecosystem and will design and run the machines behind each functional area and act as the connective tissue across them. The Strat ecosystem is a net new design for our team, and this role is critical to operationalizing it successfully. You'll report to the management partner of the AE Strat Group, who will be your primary point of triangulation and sign\-off on design, and you will partner directly with each Strategist in running their individual functional areas. Beyond the Strategists, you'll work closely with Analysts, Strategist Coordinators, Client Service, and Research teams where the ecosystem intersects with them.



You will drive the following responsibilities:


* Operational design: You will collaborate directly with the manager and the Strategists to internalize the goals of each area, design a machine to deliver them, evolve it through time, and establish connections between them.
* Functional ownership: You will be a trusted voice on the state of our ecosystem and its component parts, meaningfully guide the overall direction and priorities, maintain a precise synthesis on how things are going, and surface/address issues before they become problems.
* Operational Execution: You will own the full cadence of recurring mechanisms across the ecosystem — annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, and ad hoc — keeping the team on track and working fluidly and working through blockers/problems that may be getting in the way.
* Ecosystem Status \& Reporting: You will maintain a standing view of how the ecosystem is running – health of each area, overall priorities and problems, status of key mechanisms, upcoming milestones – and bubble up that synthesis to the manager and more broadly to the Strat group.


You will be a click for the role if:


* You think in systems, not just instances. You get satisfaction out of designing structure and repeatable process and want to build the muscle to do so in a highly complex, fast\-moving space.
* You are high ownership. When you see a gap nobody else is covering, you close it rather than waiting to be asked, and you reliably deliver without reminders or being chased.
* You sustain pace across many things at once. This ecosystem has several functional areas moving on different cadences simultaneously, and you hold quality and precision across all of them at all times.
* You are comfortable and energized operating within ambiguity. This role has no established playbook to lean on, so you're someone who raises your hand to ask questions, goes and gets what you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you, and is comfortable raising perceptions and ideas before you’re confident they’re right.
* You build influence through the quality of your judgment and your follow\-through, strengthening your credibility and efficacy through time.
* You're curious about Bridgewater's core business and how this group engages clients and prospects and communicates our views.


Interested in learning more about working at Bridgewater? Hear about the experiences of our employees here.



Minimum Qualifications:


* 3\-5 years of experience in a role that required you to design operational processes from scratch, manage projects or programs, own and run business operations, or a comparable function, ideally in a

This role ensures the delivery of high\-quality, evidence\-based care for individuals with opioid use disorder while supporting clinical and administrative operations, regulatory compliance, program growth, quality improvement, and patient engagement. * Supporting departmental administrative operations, including meeting coordination, calendar management, scheduling logistics, agenda preparation, and event organization

* Supporting operational initiatives that enhance OBAT services and overall program performance
* Participating in special project teams and performing other duties as assigned or directed by management

* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills define how you approach program operations and team collaboration
* You are experienced in healthcare program management and comfortable balancing clinical, administrative, operational, and strategic priorities
* You have experience in substance use disorder treatment, behavioral health, or medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) programs

jobs.title: Program Manager of NYC Parenting & Visitation Services - Safe Families Parenting & Visitation Initiative
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Program Manager!




Are you passionate about supporting Behavioral Health \& Justice InvolvedPopulations and making a real difference in their lives? EAC Network, a leading not\-for\-profit social service agency dedicated to helping over 79,000 people through 100 impactful programs across Long Island and NYC, is looking for a dedicated full time**Program Manager of Parenting \& Visitation Services**to join **Safe Families Parenting \& Visitation Initiative****s Program**.


**Salary:** $75,000\-$85,000/year**Schedule:** Monday\- Friday**:** 9AM\-5PM**Location:** 175 Remsen Street, 11th Floor in Brooklyn, NY


**What drives the core purpose of this job:**


The Program Manager, Parenting \& Visitation Services is responsible for the daily management and operation of the Safe Families Parenting \& Visitation Initiative. The Program Manager provides supervision and leadership to program staff and ensures that services are delivered in accordance with agency policies, contractual requirements, and best practices. The Program Manager is responsible for maintaining program quality, achieving performance outcomes, monitoring documentation, and supporting positive outcomes for children and families participating in supervised visitation, parenting education, and family support services. Office\-based with community engagement and occasional evening and weekend hours may be required.




**What are the key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Parenting \& Visitation Services Program.
* Supervise, train, and evaluate assigned program staff.
* Conduct regular staff meetings and individual supervision sessions.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and coverage for program operations.
* Monitor staff performance and ensure compliance with agency policies and procedures.
* Oversee supervised visitation services and parenting education activities.
* Monitor participant engagement, service delivery, and program outcomes.
* Review case records, visitation reports, service plans, and other required documentation for quality and compliance.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, and agency standards.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with courts, attorneys, ACS, community\-based organizations, and referral sources.
* Participate in case conferences, stakeholder meetings, and community outreach activities as required.
* Ensure timely and accurate collection of program data and required reports.
* Monitor progress toward program goals and contractual performance measures.
* Assist in the preparation of reports and documentation required by funders and EAC leadership.
* Review and approve employee timesheets, schedules, and leave requests.
* Assist with budget management and program expenditures.
* Ensure program facilities are maintained in a safe, welcoming, and professional manner.
* Coordinate with security personnel and security vendors to ensure adequate coverage, adherence to safety protocols, and a secure environment for children, families, staff, and visitors.
* Monitor safety concerns and respond appropriately to incidents, emergencies, and disruptive situations.
* Respond to client concerns, incidents, safety issues, and emergencies as needed.
* Participate in agency meetings, trainings, and quality improvement activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.




**What key knowledge, skills, and abilities are required to excel in this role:**

* Knowledge of family services, parenting programs, supervised visitation practices, and child welfare systems.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills and ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, participants, funders, courts, referral sources, and community partners.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and electronic data management systems.




**What We Offer:**
