* Additionally, all employees are eligible to participate in EAC Network’s 401(k) plan, and full\-time employees receive a 3% employer contribution after one year of service. EAC employees may also be eligible for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. At EAC Network, you are part of a team making a difference in our communities across Long Island and New York City, every day.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager II, Shopping Platforms
jobs.description:
**About Pinterest:**



Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.



Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.



At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.



Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

**The Team**


* Pinterest's Shopping \& Delivery Infrastructure team builds and operates the catalog, indexing, retrieval, and serving systems that power Shopping and ads across every Pinterest surface, from search and homefeed to P2P and international markets. Our mission is to make Pinterest's shopping and delivery stack unified, scalable, and low\-latency so we can drive sustainable revenue growth, exceptional Pinner experiences, and measurable advertiser outcomes. We're in the middle of a multi\-year transformation of the stack, and we work closely with catalog, indexing, retrieval, serving, ads quality, and product teams to make Pinterest's shopping infrastructure faster, more reliable, and ready to scale.


**What You'll Do**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for dynamic consultants to grow our Engineering team in **United States**. Your experience, knowledge, and commitment will help us to face our client's challenges.


You will be supporting different projects through your expertise as **Project Manager.**

  



Your main responsibilities:


* Lead the complete implementation lifecycle of **UKG Pro Workforce Management** across manufacturing sites in Mexico and Costa Rica.
* Align workforce management configuration with Free Trade Zone requirements, local tax and audit rules, labor regulations, overtime, holidays, premiums, and payroll practices.
* Coordinate integrations between UKG, global payroll platforms, localized ERP systems, HR applications, banking interfaces, and other regional systems.
* Translate complex manufacturing requirements into system configurations, including 24/7 operations, rotating shifts, skill\-based assignments, line placement, meal breaks, and plant scheduling rules.
* Direct the remote deployment and configuration of biometric timekeeping terminals and mobile geo\-fenced applications across secure facility checkpoints.
* Design and lead multi\-currency UAT, data validation, parallel payroll testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, go\-live, and post\-implementation support.

Qualifications:


* Minimum of **6 years of IT Project Management experience**, specifically leading enterprise\-scale Workforce Management or HRIS platform implementations.
* Documented experience managing at least one complete implementation or migration of **UKG Pro Workforce Management**, formerly UKG Dimensions.
* Proven experience working in high\-volume manufacturing, assembly, industrial logistics, or other multi\-shift operational environments.
* Direct hands\-on experience deploying business software platforms in both **Mexico and Costa Rica**, including knowledge of regional labor requirements and Free Trade Zone environments.
* Professional working fluency in **English and Spanish**, with the ability to collaborate with regional project teams, payroll partners, HR stakeholders, and plant personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience, Associate’s degree with at least 6 years of relevant experience, or high school diploma with at least 8 years of relevant experience. **PMP or Certified ScrumMaster certification is required or strongly preferred.**

Why choose us


* An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities
* An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level
* A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available
* A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)

  

Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

  



\#LI\-JM1


**Who are we?**
---------------


**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  

  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  

  

**Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  

  

**Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  

  

**Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  

  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  

We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Program Manager - Transparency of Reciprocity Information System
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Lead proactive counterintelligence and security activities across the United States government, integrating the instruments of national power to detect, report, deter, disrupt, investigate, exploit, and defeat foreign intelligence threats.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


Open to current and former Federal employees with competitive or excepted status; and all U.S. Citizens. Former members of the Peace Corps may be considered for ODNI employment only if five full years have elapsed since separation from the Peace Corps.


  
**Duties**
----------


The National Counterintelligence and Security Center (NCSC) is dedicated to leading the U.S. Counterintelligence and Security communities, countering all threats posed by adversarial foreign intelligence affiliated threats and enhancing our national security posture at every level. We will serve as the head of U.S. counterintelligence and integrate the instruments of national power to counter foreign intelligence threats. NCSC will be the "center of gravity" to support the counterintelligence and security efforts of the entire U.S. interagency, and public sector initiatives to protect our nation from adversarial efforts to exploit the U.S. and victimize the American people.  

  

The Mission Capabilities Directorate (MCD) drives enterprise technical and information sharing solutions, prioritizes and manages requirements in support of whole\-of\-government counterintelligence and security mission partners. MCD identifies mission gaps, builds capabilities through full lifecycle program development, drives data analytics and technical innovation, delivers threat RFIs/assessments, coordinates interagency partners, and ensures legal/policy/civil liberties compliance. MCD is seeking an outstanding IT Program Manager (PM) to join a team of mission\-focused leaders who identify and develop integrated capabilities on behalf of the Counterintelligence and Security community. The IT PM for Transparency of Reciprocity Information System (ToRIS) will oversee the development, implementation, and operation of this system, ensuring alignment with NCSC strategic objectives, Trusted Workforce 2\.0 priorities, and Intelligence Community\-wide personnel security modernization efforts. This role requires strong IT and program management expertise, outstanding communication and briefing skills, senior\-level management capabilities, and the ability to negotiate interagency agreements for data and information sharing. This is a high\-visibility leadership role with direct impact on reciprocity, transfer of trust, personnel vetting, workforce mobility, and secure personnel security data sharing across the Intelligence Community. The IT PM for ToRIS oversees a mission\-critical, IC\-wide capability supporting Trusted Workforce 2\.0 and Security Reform initiatives. This position provides oversight for system budget, scope, and timelines, and leads coordination with IC elements, DCSA, PAC PMO, and other executive branch stakeholders to modernize personnel security data sharing, improve reciprocity, and reduce friction in clearance and transfer\-of\-trust processes. This position also ensures ToRIS capabilities are developed and delivered in accordance with applicable legal, privacy, civil liberties, and policy requirements.  

  

Primary Responsibilities:  

Provide leadership and/or oversight to complex IT projects or programs that may include ill\-defined requirements, ambiguity, parallel tasks, multiple dependencies, high risks, and multiple interfaces; ensure alignment with strategic or corporate objectives; lead the definition and review of customer and stakeholder requirements; ensure plans and schedules are developed and followed throughout the life of the project.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us**


eSimplicity is a modern digital services company that works across government, partnering with our clients to improve the health and lives of millions of Americans, ensure the security of all Americans—from soldiers and veterans to kids and the elderly, and defend national interests on the battlefield. Our engineers, designers, and strategists cut through complexity to create intuitive products and services that courageously equip Federal agencies with solutions to transform today for a better tomorrow for all Americans.


We are seeking a driven and organized Project Manager to join our team. The Project Manager will support program leadership in ensuring projects are executed smoothly and seamlessly and will own operational logistics across multiple teams. Project Managers assist with program\-level reporting, own successful team onboarding, track and manage logistical work at the program level, facilitate program ceremonies, and more. You will be a good fit if you have a strong sense of responsibility and ownership and thrive in a fast\-paced environment.


This role is contingent upon successful Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) suitability determination.


**Responsibilities:**

* Support program reporting, including status updates, milestones, action items, and performance metrics.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies and delivery coordination across project teams.
* Create and maintain work items, ensuring tickets reflect agreed requirements, decisions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Formalize stakeholder direction into actionable work, track open questions and dependencies, and follow items through resolution.
* Support backlog organization, delivery planning, and prioritization.
* Maintain resource forecasts and support program financial tracking, including staffing plans, utilization, burn, and anticipated changes.
* Coordinate program communications, product release readiness evaluations, production support ticket operations, team meetings, documentation, and team onboarding/offboarding.
* Maintain team rosters, collaboration channels, and other shared program resources.

**Competencies:**

* **Organization and Follow\-Through:** Maintains clear ownership, dependencies, deadlines, and action items, and drives work through resolution.
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly across technical, product, program, and customer stakeholders and produces concise, useful documentation.
* **Delivery Coordination:** Keeps teams aligned around priorities, upcoming work, blockers, and decisions across multiple concurrent efforts.
* **Agile Facilitation:** Effectively facilitates team ceremonies and supports healthy backlog management and delivery practices.
* **Judgment and Adaptability:** Operates effectively in ambiguous environments, identifies where clarification or escalation is needed, and adjusts as priorities change.


Requirements:
* U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements. Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability or Public Trust determination.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, or a similar role supporting software development teams in an Agile environment.
* 2\+ years of experience supporting federal government programs or working in the government contracting industry.
* Experience using Agile/Kanban practices and project management tools to organize work, maintain backlogs, track dependencies, and support delivery.
* Experience supporting resource planning, forecasting, program financial tracking, or similar project management functions.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting multiple concurrent projects or workstreams.
* Experience supporting federal digital services or modernization programs.
* Experience supporting projects for data platforms and data solutions


eSimplicity supports a remote work environment operating within the Eastern time zone so we can work with and respond to our government clients. Expected hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern unless otherwise directed by your manager.


Occasional travel for training and project meetings. It is estimated to be less than 5% per year.

**Benefits:**


eSimplicity offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement benefits, paid time off, paid holidays, life and disability insurance, and additional wellness and employee support programs. Eligibility may vary based on employment status and applicable plan terms.

eSimplicity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process. Applicants who need assistance or an accommodation should contact Human Resources.


**Equal Employment Opportunity:**  

eSimplicity is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

**Position Overview:** The Senior Project Manager supports the planning, execution, and monitoring of multiple, simultaneous projects within the GSM\-O II contract supporting DISA. This role ensures projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget, while adhering to Agile methodologies and relevant policies. **Primary Responsibilities**

* Establish and communicate project vision, strategy, and goals, driving clarity and accountability across cross\-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.

* Direct project operations, communications, and executive\-level reporting for senior leadership, including the Program Director and Deputy Program Manager.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, partners, and executive leadership.

Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.

  

  

The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real\-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross\-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.
  

  

We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Sr. Manager, Data Analytics to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI\-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

  

  

**On a given day you will be:**


* Refining a new Enterprise\-wide analytical tools validation framework
* Planning and executing validation projects
* Assessing the quality and risk of analytical tool methodologies across Capital One, and the nature of tools usage within those processes
* Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities
* Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools
* Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via validation reports and presentations
* Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems
* Coaching and mentoring junior staff
  

  

An ideal candidate will possess strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills. This position will be in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.

  

  

**Basic Qualifications:**


* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 5 years of experience performing professional data analysis work
* At least 5 years of experience leading and developing with open source data technologies
* At least 2 years of experience managing people
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Master’s Degree or PhD in a Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field
* At least 7 years of experience in statistical or econometrics hands\-on work
* At least 5 years of experience manipulating and performing analysis with large data sets
* At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry
* At least 5 years of experience in developing statistical or econometric models
* At least 5 years of experience in validating statistical or econometric models
* At least 2 years of experience with data governance
* At least 2 years of experience with predictive analytics

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager to join Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation (NASO). A successful candidate will assume a critical role in overseeing and leading engineering and technical services to support maintenance and planning for the overhaul and repair equipment and systems associated with U.S. Navy Surface Ships. This position would be located in Yokosuka, Japan.  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your DoD Secret level clearance.**  

Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation is part of our high\-performing Maritime, Engineering, Technology, and Sustainment Business Unit which provides critical services to nearly all U.S. Navy surface ships, submarines and craft and is achieving truly impactful outcomes. Serco has over 9,000 people in North America, with operations across the U.S. and Canada. We are committed to forming long\-term partnerships and supporting Federal and State government customers to achieve their mission.  

**In this role you will:**
* Lead teams providing technical guidance to Ship's Force relating to work on Hull, Mechanical \& Electrical (HM\&E) and aviation equipment and systems which interface with combat support systems, and hull support items such as damage control equipment for flooding and fire, climate control/ventilation systems, tank and voids, plenums, etc., habitability improvements, and piping systems. Also encompassed are electrical generation, power and distribution systems including controllers, junction boxes, cabling, and cableways.
* Lead the performance of inspections, examinations, analysis, repairs incidental to such and make recommendations in the areas of maintenance planning and/or repair as requested on naval propulsion and auxiliary machinery associated with high pressure steam propulsion plants and U.S. Naval Surface Force Ship propulsion plants and auxiliaries.
* Liaison with ship’s reactor department is required prior to accomplishing inspections, testing, and production work.
* Manage teams performing, assisting, or providing technical guidance on the performance of fault identification and support Ship's Force with physical repairs of the types of naval propulsion and auxiliary and aviation/flight deck equipment/combat systems and systems set forth herein
* Responsible for technical support and advice to Ship's Force pertinent to the operation, overhaul, and repair of specific items of, auxiliary machinery, electrical, and hull support and aviation systems as directed by the appropriate technical authority.
* Oversee the performance or provide guidance IAW Corrosion Control Assessment and Maintenance Manual (CCAMM) for the Maintenance System Work Package Planning (MSWP) (T\-9630\-ABMMD\-010/all USN hulls) to Ship's Force with training, inspection and reporting of tanks, voids, plenums, bilges, catwalks, pump room decks, and Aqueous Film Forming Foam (AFFF) station decks. Perform or provide technical guidance in support of TYCOM Cableway Improvement Program (CIP) in accordance with NAVSEAINST 9304 series to Ship's Force with training, inspection, repair assistance and reporting.
* Develop updated training package to the TYCOM and to the RMCs. Provide formal on\-board operator and maintenance training to Ship’s Force.
* Develop Formal Work Packages (FWPs) and Controlled Work Packages (CWPs) in accordance with the Joint Fleet Maintenance Manual.
* Manage personnel as required to support short\-term and long\-term contract efforts.
* Cultivating positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**
* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of seven years’ experience in related engineering management field, or Associates Degree with fourteen (14\) years’ experience in related engineering management field.
* Five years’ supervisory experience in the area of technical assistance, maintenance, or design related to surface ships.
* Three years should be closely involved with practical aircraft carrier/surface ship (as applicable) maintenance, design, operation, and other problems of main propulsion, auxiliary,electrical, and damage control equipment associated with shipboard level maintenance.
* Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical, and damage control systems and included steam propulsion plants.
* Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
* Two years of supervisory experience.
* A current DoD security clearance or able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance post\-employment.
* United States (U.S.) citizenship.
* Up to 25% of travel for CONUS/OCONUS may be required.

**Knowledge, ability and skills:**
* Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
* Ability to lead and manage large teams.
* Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.

If you’re ready to contribute your skills and expertise to help manage and execute successful programs, apply today to join the Serco\-NA team. Your efforts will be key to ensuring project success and supporting our overall mission.

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Senior Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) International Directorate (ID), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), in in acting as the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. jobs.title: Tech Infra Program Manager, Non-Standard Infrastructure Delivery (NSID)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

About the Role  

The AWS Non\-Standard Infrastructure Global Delivery Team builds and scales infrastructure for AWS programs that don't fit neatly into traditional data center models. Our projects are tailored to the specific needs of internal and external customers — from satellite ground stations that downlink data from orbit, to specialized labs where engineers develop custom silicon and push the boundaries of quantum computing, to purpose\-built environments with precision environmental controls for archival storage systems, to infrastructure that extends the AWS network to the furthest edge of its global footprint. Each program brings its own constraints, its own technical requirements, and often its own first\-of\-kind design challenges.  

What makes this team unique is the degree of ambiguity we operate in. Many of our projects begin as loosely defined requests from internal customer teams who know what they need to accomplish but not necessarily what infrastructure it takes to get there. A significant part of this role is working upstream with those customers to develop initial requirements, define technical scope, build demand forecasts, and refine scaling models — often for infrastructure types where no established playbook exists. The solutions we deliver are boutique by nature: custom\-designed to meet specific programmatic needs, site constraints, and operational models that vary from project to project.
  

The scope is broad, the problems are novel, and the pace of growth means we are constantly onboarding new infrastructure types and scaling models.  

If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy the challenge of translating vague asks into engineered solutions, and want to shape how AWS builds and scales its infrastructure globally — this role is for you.  

We have an immediate opening for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III to drive capacity delivery across multiple non\-standard infrastructure programs worldwide. You will lead cross\-functional teams through the full lifecycle of infrastructure delivery — from upstream requirements definition and demand forecasting through design development, procurement, construction, commissioning, and deployment. You will develop and implement scalable mechanisms for tracking program health, drive data\-driven decisions influencing significant capital investments, and work with stakeholders across AWS to solve constraints, remove blockers, and accelerate delivery.  

Your work will span:  

* Requirements development — Working with internal customer teams to translate ambiguous needs into defined technical requirements, scope documents, and infrastructure specifications for novel deployment types
* Stakeholder management and influence — Navigating complex, matrixed organizational structures and influencing without authority to align diverse teams, secure resources, drive decisions, and maintain momentum across programs where no single team owns the end\-to\-end outcome
* Demand forecasting and capacity planning — Building initial demand models and scaling forecasts for programs where historical baselines don't exist, and refining them as programs mature
* Boutique design coordination — Partnering with engineering teams to develop tailored infrastructure solutions that meet unique programmatic constraints (environmental, regulatory, physical, operational)
* Multi\-year delivery execution — Driving complex, globally distributed projects from conceptual feasibility through budget approval, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning
* Cross\-program coordination — Identifying synergies, shared solutions, and lessons learned across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure types
* Mechanism development — Building scalable processes and reporting to monitor delivery health, drive accountability, and escalate to leadership as the portfolio grows


This role offers an opportunity to drive and influence business\-critical decisions impacting the long\-term future of AWS, working at the leading edge of emerging capability and service offerings. You must be comfortable managing remote project teams delivering novel — and sometimes pioneering — solutions across multiple countries and time zones; operating as the connective tissue between customer teams with undefined needs and engineering teams who build solutions; assessing and mitigating downstream risk; troubleshooting unforeseen implementation issues; removing barriers to project success; and operating effectively amid persistent uncertainty and change.  

Up to 15% domestic and international travel may be necessary to support AWS non\-standard infrastructure planning and scaling efforts.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work upstream with internal customer teams to elicit, define, and document technical requirements for infrastructure programs that are often undefined or loosely scoped at inception
* Develop initial demand forecasts and capacity scaling models for emerging

**GRC Consultant**


**Hybrid variable Birmingham OR London**


We are looking for a Information Security manager/GRC Consultant, you will play a key role in the ‘IT Security team’ protecting the organisation against information security threats. This includes maintaining existing security measures while continuously enhancing our governance, risk management and compliance (GRC) frameworks and policies. You will work closely with the ‘Information Security Steering Team’ and cross\-functional departments to ensure it is compliant with regulatory requirements and protected from evolving threats.

* Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) in accordance with ISO 27001

* Prepare and present reports on information security including areas for improvement
* Manage and update content for the information security awareness platform for employees and key suppliers, ensuring up\-to\-date training on information and cybersecurity best practices
* Research and recommend security enhancements and improvements

* Significant experience in Information Security and GRC
* Strong understanding of risk management methodologies and international security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, US NIST, TSA, etc.) and the ability to assess risks, identify vulnerabilities, etc.
* Familiarity with data privacy legislation such as EU GDPR
* Experience maintaining and auditing Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) in line with ISO 27001
* Customer service\-oriented with the ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders
* Analytical and creative thinking skills, with the ability to identify pragmatic solutions

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst II
jobs.description:
As a Senior Research Analyst II within the Acrylates and Oxo Alcohol Market Advisory Services team, you will contribute to the monthly data gathering, review and analysis for reports used by global chemical producers, traders, and procurement managers. You will focus on the EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa) region, specifically tracking trends and pricing within the Acrylate Monomers, MMA, Oxo Alcohols, and Plasticizers value chains.


**You Will**


* Price Discovery \& Reporting: Support in assessing monthly spot and contract prices for Acrylate Monomers (2\-EHA, BA, EA and MA), Methyl Methacrylate (MMA), Superabsorbent Polymers (SAP), Oxo\-Alcohols (2\-EH, n\-Butanol, iso\-Butanol), and various Plasticizers.
* Price Forecasting: Analyze and interpret how changes in upstream energy and feedstock costs (e.g., Propylene, Natural Gas) will interact with market forces to create multi\-year, monthly price forecasts for Acrylates, MMA, SAP and Oxo Alcohols.
* Report Creation: Assist in writing and compiling monthly Market Advisory reports andcontributing data for longer\-term World Analysis forecasts through 2060\. Regularly interfaces with global Market Advisory Services team members to ensure analysis consistency and to be kept abreast of global trends that could affect regional markets.
* Supply/Demand Modeling: Support in maintaining and updating Global Supply/DemandBalances for the EMEA region, as well as updating plant capacities, production rates and future expansions.
* Trade Flow Analysis: Work with the greater global ASAP and GOAP team to keep updated on arbitrage opportunities and global supply\-demand status.
* Client Support: Initially support and assist the EMEA Principal Analyst with scheduled calls and meetings to gather market intel, with the near\-term expectation the Senior Research Analyst II can soon handle some calls independently. Also eventually moving to the position of being able to independently respond to some unscheduled, incoming market queries.

**You Have:**


* University degree required. Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Engineering or Chemistry is highly preferred. Alternate degrees may include Finance, Mathematics, Journalism or Business Analytics with a demonstrated interest or minor in a science\-related field. Any real\-world chemical industry experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated organized ability to research through established contacts with diverse market participant channels in telephone, e\-mail and face\-to\-face interfaces; ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ideal candidate will have proficiency in Microsoft Office Professional suite, with emphasis on Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Candidate will be able to manage large datasets and interpret formulas to ensure accurate maintenance of customer\-facing data. Candidate will also be able to extrapolate internal data to help create customer\-facing charts, graphs and presentations.
* Exceptional written and spoken English is required for publishing reports for a global audience.
* Proficiency in other languages is a plus. Preference given to those with knowledge of Spanish, German, French or Arabic.
* The ideal candidate will be outgoing and understand this role requires a significant number of monthly phone calls, Zoom calls and meetings. Candidate must have an engaging personality and willingness to engage in cultivating both existing and new client\-facing relationships.

**Our Benefits**


* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Family Care Benefits
* Access to Dow Jones Products

jobs.description:
**Please read the job description, criteria and application process notes carefully before applying. This role has a fixed start date of 11 January 2027 and is based full\-time on\-site in Central London. Closing date for applications will be mid October.**

**About Prevail Partners**


Prevail Partners is a leading British intelligence, security and operational support company. We help governments, NGOs and commercial organisations operate safely and effectively in some of the world's most complex environments by combining intelligence, technology and operational expertise. Our teams deliver actionable insight that helps clients manage risk, make informed decisions and achieve meaningful operational impact where it matters most.


Our shared mission is to deliver unrelenting excellence in everything we do, underpinned by integrity, curiosity, accountability and care.


**About the Role**


The Graduate Intelligence Analyst Programme is an opportunity for people looking to start their career in intelligence analysis to develop their problem\-solving and analytical skills while gaining practical insight into the intelligence field. At Prevail, the Graduate Intelligence Analyst will apply skills developed through study, professional experience, or personal research to help solve complex client problems through structured training and on\-the\-job learning.


The programme includes an initial three\-month training phase with structured lessons, rotations through project teams working on live operations and deliverables, and exposure to supporting functions such as Geospatial and Data. This is followed by a three\-month probationary period as a Graduate Intelligence Analyst within one of Prevail’s teams, applying training with support from peers, the manager, and a dedicated Mentor Analyst.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis to support live client operations.
* Contribute to intelligence products and reports that inform client decision\-making.
* Support 24/7 monitoring activity by identifying, assessing, and escalating relevant developments.
* Collaborate with supporting functions, including Geospatial and Data, to enrich analysis and outputs.
* Present findings clearly and confidently in written reports and verbally to internal teams and, where relevant, clients.
* Continuously develop analytical tradecraft by incorporating feedback from the Mentor Analyst, manager, peers, and wider team.

  

**Requirements** **Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Recent university graduate, or professional actively seeking a career change into intelligence with proven self\-study and research in a related field.
* Understanding of Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection, tools, and analysis.
* Proactive, curious mindset, with the ability to learn quickly, innovate, contribute fresh ideas, challenge existing processes, and improve workflows.
* Strong understanding of current affairs, geopolitical trends, and national security issues, with the ability to analyse global events and international relations and assess their relevance to intelligence operations.
* Able to achieve SC security clearance, including meeting UK residency and vetting requirements.
* Available to start full\-time work on 11 January 2027 and able to commute to and work on\-site daily in a Central London office.
* Willing to join the team’s weekend duty rota after completing probation (time off in lieu for weekend hours worked).
* Strong IT literacy, including the Microsoft Office Suite.
* Able to handle sensitive information with discretion, professionalism, and respect for confidentiality.

**Desirable Skills and Experience:**

* Foreign language skills, particularly French, Russian, Arabic, or Farsi.
* Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI for presenting intelligence findings.

**Compensation:**
The typical salary range for this position is USD $155,000 \- $185,000 per year. Individual pay is determined by many factors including work location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a comprehensive total rewards package that includes an annual performance bonus, an employer\-funded Profit\-Sharing Plan (PSP) contribution based on base compensation, and comprehensive employer\-paid medical benefits, PTO pay\-out options, along with additional company\-sponsored benefits. **About the company**

 **Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company,** is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality. **Home Organizers, Inc.** is the parent organization behind a portfolio of well\-known home products and services brands, including Closet World, Closets by Design, Brio Water Technology, and others. With decades of experience supporting innovation, design, manufacturing, and customer focused solutions, Home Organizers helps its brands deliver high quality products and services that improve everyday living for households across the country. **About the role**  

As part of Home Organizers, Inc., Brio Water Technology is looking for a Program Manager, Technology to build the program governance, standards, and processes that do not yet exist within our technology organization. This is a foundational, hands\-on role for someone who walks into ambiguity and sees opportunity rather than a problem.  

This role is deliberately two jobs in one. As the business analyst, you define the problem, outline the scope, and make sure the solution fits what the business actually needs. As the program manager, you own the budget, hold the timeline, and deliver through the team. We are looking for someone who does both, and who knows which one a given moment calls for.  

The right person starts with people, not plans: they talk to our internal customers, learn their pain points, understand the current state, and use what they learn to design the processes and procedures we do not yet have. They are proactive by default. Wherever there is a compliance concern, an undocumented procedure, or a process with no owner, they step in, create clarity, and carry it until a permanent owner is in place. They do not wait to be assigned work; they find the gaps, close them, and hand them off.  

This person arrives with Agile coaching experience already in hand. As our teams mature and grow, they will take on Scrum Master duties and coach teams of varying size and experience. All of it requires influence without authority, and comfort operating alongside senior leaders and executives who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems actually behave. **Objectives of the role*** Establish the program governance, standards, and compliance foundation our technology organization does not yet have, in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
* Take ownership of gaps: compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and unowned processes, creating clarity and carrying them until a permanent owner is in place.
* Lead cross\-functional technology programs end to end, from problem definition and requirements through delivery, coordinating teams and vendors outside your direct management chain.
* Take on the role of Scrum Master, Agile Coach, and business analyst for one or more teams as our organization matures.

 **What you'll do*** **Strategic planning.** Define the roadmap, goals, and long\-term vision for assigned programs, and sequence the work so near\-term delivery builds toward the target state.
* **Business analysis.** Define the problem before the solution is chosen. Elicit and document requirements, map current and future state, set scope, and write acceptance criteria, confirming that what gets built fits what the business actually needs.
* **Stakeholder communication.** Serve as the primary bridge between project teams, executives, and external partners. Run working sessions, keep everyone current on status, risks, and decisions, and work directly with stakeholders up to the executive level and with subject matter experts who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems behave.
* **Change management and adoption.** Many of our teams have worked in the same systems, using the same processes, for a very long time. Adoption here is earned, not announced. Communicate change early and often, brief the leadership of each area before rollout so their questions are answered ahead of go\-live, and provide the training and hands\-on support people need to work confidently in the new process. Success is measured by adoption, not by the go\-live date.
* **Program delivery.** Lead cross\-functional technology programs end to end: system implementations, migrations, and infrastructure initiatives, coordinating teams outside your direct management chain, including external vendors, internal business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
* **Cross\-project coordination.** Manage interdependencies across concurrent projects, surface scheduling and resource conflicts early, and drive them to resolution.
* **Budget oversight.** Allocate resources, forecast expenses, and own budget adherence and variance tracking for assigned programs, including vendor software licensing, capital expenses for infrastructure upgrades, and cloud costs.
* **Risk management.** Identify roadblocks and risks early and implement corrective action. Maintain the risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit\-ready documentation.
* **Governance and gap ownership.** Stand up program governance where none exists today. Proactively identify compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and processes without a clear owner; create interim structure, carry ownership, and hand off to permanent owners once established.
* **Agile leadership.** Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, coaching teams of varying size and maturity as the organization scales.

**Positions Supervised**: PM Team

**Status**: Full Time

Westnet LLC., is a cutting\-edge leader in providing First Responder communications systems to Fire Departments, military bases and 911 Dispatch centers throughout the country. We are seeking a customer\-focused Systems Integrator Project Manager to join our Project Management team.

The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated, team\-oriented individual who will work closely with our sales, production, installation, and technical support departments to lead the planning, execution, and final deployment of complex technical projects that combine software applications, hardware systems, and networks into unified environments.

· Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and critical paths, making revisions as project conditions change.

jobs.description:
Overview:

BAI, a defense contractor, is seeking an Information Security Analyst with 3\+ years of experience, to support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity practices across assigned information systems and environments at Naval Base Ventura Point Mugu Ca. This position executes security protocols and procedures, monitors compliance with established security requirements, conducts assessments and audits, supports accreditation activities, and provides technical guidance on security tools and controls. Opportunities for career advancement, excellent benefits and long\-term stability are some of the advantages of our growing, employee\-focused company. **Salary**
The typical annual salary range for this position is $110,000\.00 USD to $140,000\.00 USD. Salary will be based on current qualifications, directly related experience, geographic location, and possible contractual requirements which could fall outside of this range.  


Responsibilities:
* Between 3 and 10 years of practical CEAT computer security experience in secure network and system design, analysis, procedure/test generation, test execution and implementation of computer/network security mechanisms

* **CYBER**
* Works closely with the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), Cybersecurity Lead, system owners, and functional support/technical teams to protect computer networks, information systems, digital files, and critical electronic infrastructure
* Implements and monitors security controls, protocols, and procedures
* Protects networks, systems, information, and critical infrastructure
* Conducts vulnerability assessments, audits, risk reviews and rapid response reporting and data calls
* Monitors for and respond to security incidents, breaches, and malware in coordination with the ISSM and/or Cybersecurity Lead
* Prepares and maintains accreditation and compliance documentation
* Supports the implementation and use of security tools
* Provides security training and recommend improvements to security processes and controls

* **DevSecOps**
* Integrates security into a continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous deployment pipeline to minimize vulnerabilities in software code
* Ensures the entire DevOps team, including developers and operations teams, share responsibility for following security best practices
* Enables automated security checks at each stage of software delivery by integrating security controls, tools, and processes into the DevOps workflow
* Assists in the continuous integration, continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD), continuous feedback, and continuous operations cycle


Qualifications:
* IAT/IAM II as per DoD Manual 8140; Certifications: Security\+, CISSP, or NSA equivalent
* Experience working with the Risk Management Framework processes
* Strong DEVSECOPS (proficient with Linux is a plus)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills—verbal, non\-verbal, written, and listening for staff, customer, and organizational level communications, both formal and informal
* Ability to work independently, self\-starter
* Working knowledge and use of Microsoft Office suite programs, MS Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint

 **EDUCATION**

**Degree:** BS or BA degree in Computer Information Systems or a relevant technical discipline

**Allowable Substitution:** An additional 6 years of relevant work experience may be substituted for a Bachelor’s Degree, or 4 additional years of work experience with a relevant Associate’s Degree

**CLEARANCE**

**Condition of Employment:** Must have a T5 background investigation, active Top Secret Security Clearance, and be able to maintain a DoD Top Secret Security Clearance. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.


**CITIZENSHIP**


The applicant must have US citizenship at the time of application.

  

BAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other non\-merit based factors made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life\-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. Our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

 **Position Summary:**  

The Business Analyst is responsible for leading the strategic development and implementation of process improvement and technology solutions across enterprise patient access. This role has responsibility for improving patient access related workflows, establishing standard work, optimizing technology solutions, and developing effective training programs. Perform and manage complex data analysis to determine process improvement opportunities, evaluate alternatives and prioritize redesign efforts that address the strategic needs of the organization. Serves as a Liaison between access operations and other internal departments. Works alongside the Senior Business Analyst, responsible for business process management which includes developing and maintaining a repository of organizational and tactical objectives, process documentation, reporting, database management, analysis, department/unit metrics and key performance indicators. Routinely reviews and analyzes business process, intake and coordination, workflow management, and job functions to provide insight and suggestions for improvements. Participates in projects to develop business case during project initiation, identify business needs, and assist in change management strategies or changes throughout the project life cycle.

**As a successful candidate, you will:**

**Process Improvement:**  

Assists management in identifying opportunities to improve business operations and the overall patient experience. Documents current state, recommendations for future state, implementation planning and timeline, and expected benefit. Presents recommendations and full business case to leadership.  

**Technology Optimization:**  

Takes the lead in maintaining and improving process automation through system enhancements. Recommends technology solutions through research and analysis of data and business processes.  

**Data Analysis:**  

Analyze, review, forecast, and trend big and complex data sets. Performs ad hoc analyses, including prospective modeling and retrospective trending. Able to develop data plans, data request, data acquisition, data cleansing, and perform analytics.

**Your qualifications should include:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience may substitute for minimum education requirements.
* At least three years of a combination of healthcare management and process improvement experience in patient access
* Project management experience a plus

* Develop, maintain, and update GIS databases and geodatabases.

* Maintain standardized workflows for data collection, storage, and reporting.
* Support implementation of enterprise GIS and data management initiatives.

* Coordinate with clients, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders regarding GIS and data requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and data management solutions.

A. POSITION PURPOSE


Under the supervision of the Sr. Assistant Dean / Chief Operating Officer and in close coordination with project co\-leads, the Project Manager provides administrative, operational, and tactical leadership for the implementation of the $10 Million Lilly Endowment Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant. This 5\-year grant project supports the launch and integration of the Pope Francis Institute for Pastoral Flourishing (PFI), the relocation and integration of JST\-SCU into Santa Clara University’s main campus, and the expansion of regional and national network partnerships.


The Project Manager serves as the primary operational engine driving daily grant activities. This position is responsible for ensuring all strategic deliverables, sub\-project timelines, inter\-departmental workflows, budget tracking, and official compliance reporting to the Lilly Endowment are executed seamlessly, accurately, and on schedule.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1\. Grant Project Management \& Operational Execution


* Serve as the central point of tactical execution, project tracking, and workflow management for all initiatives funded under the $10M Lilly LSC Grant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive master project plans, timelines, work breakdown structures, and milestone tracking frameworks across all grant components.

Description:

If you're passionate about restoring California's natural landscapes and want to be involved in the entire restoration process from concept through implementation and long\-term success, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact. As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you'll help lead and grow HELIX's expanding habitat restoration practice in Northern California while working alongside a team that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains restoration projects entirely in\-house.

**Why HELIX?**


At HELIX Environmental Planning, we take pride in delivering innovative environmental solutions that make a meaningful difference. Our team works on diverse public and private sector projects across California, from coastal habitats to mountain ecosystems and the Central Valley. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to handle every stage of habitat restoration under one roof, from planning and permitting to plant propagation, field implementation, and biological monitoring. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** role offers a unique chance to join a growing Northern California team and help shape the future of our restoration services. We offer a flexible hybrid work schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work.

**Day in the Life**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, no two days are the same. You may start your morning collaborating with biologists and restoration practitioners on a large\-scale habitat restoration design, spend the afternoon evaluating a field site, and finish the day helping secure funding for future restoration efforts. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** works closely with regulatory agencies, field crews, project managers, and clients while helping lead restoration projects from planning through implementation and adaptive management.

**What You'll Do**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you will:

* Design and support habitat restoration projects to achieve project goals and success criteria.
* Lead site investigations and restoration feasibility assessments.
* Collaborate with field restoration crews during project implementation and adaptive management.
* Develop habitat restoration plans and support environmental permitting efforts.
* Assist with restoration grant applications and project development.
* Conduct and oversee biological surveys, vegetation mapping, and special\-status species surveys.
* Lead biological monitoring for restoration and construction projects.
* Support wetland permit applications and regulatory documentation.
* Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and project interviews.
* Travel occasionally overnight as project needs require.

**Compensation**


Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of **$130,000 to $160,000**.

**Ready to Grow Your Career?**


If you're an experienced **Senior Restoration Project Manager** looking to advance habitat restoration throughout Northern California while helping build and grow a thriving restoration program, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and join HELIX in creating positive environmental outcomes that last for generations.


HELIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and an inclusive work environment. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of gender, race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or veteran status. These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring, appraisal systems, promotions, training, and career development programs.


PM21


Requirements:
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Botany, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience as a biologist, restoration ecologist, or restoration practitioner.
* At least 2 years of experience working in Northern California.
* Experience with field data collection methods and habitat restoration implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to hike long distances across varied terrain and weather conditions.
* Valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record.
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Environmental consulting experience.
* Society for Ecological Restoration CERP certification.
* ISA Arborist Certification.
* Wetland Delineation or Professional Wetland Scientist certifications.
* Experience coordinating with regulatory agencies.
* ArcGIS field data collection experience.
* Experience with plant propagation, equipment operation, or herbicide application.
* Experience leading biological surveys, monitoring programs, and environmental compliance efforts.

jobs.description:
### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have multiple openings for **Project Managers** to lead project\-management activities and support the planning and successful execution of high\-impact technical projects addressing critical national security challenges. You will serve as a key project\-management resource for milestone\-driven research and development efforts in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Working closely with Associate Program Leaders, Principal Investigators, technical staff, and other project stakeholders, you will help organize project teams and coordinate schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, resources, agreements, reporting, and technical communications to enable successful project execution on aggressive timelines.


You will contribute to a growing portfolio of national security research and development initiatives in areas such as cyber\-physical systems assurance, national security infrastructure, supply chain security, and disaster resilience. This position provides an opportunity to apply project\-management, technical, and operational expertise to first\-of\-a\-kind national security work while helping technical teams effectively organize, plan, coordinate, and execute complex activities. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division within the Engineering Directorate.


*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in\-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*


These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.


**In this role, you will**


* Lead day\-to\-day project\-management activities for milestone\-driven technical projects across cyber and infrastructure domains, including schedules, deliverables, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and project documentation.
* Advise and support Associate Program Leaders and Principal Investigators in project team organization, resource coordination, budget tracking, scheduling, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and progress toward technical and programmatic objectives.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize scientific and technical information for project reports, proposals, milestone deliverables, sponsor communications, and decision briefings.
* Coordinate technical and operational communications among project teams, collaborators, management, sponsors, and other stakeholders to support timely and effective project execution.
* Identify and recommend improvements to established project\-management and operational principles, methods, and tools to improve project execution, workflow, documentation, team coordination, and organizational processes.
* Coordinate documentation, schedules, deliverables, funding information, and other activities associated with contracts, subcontract\-related efforts, collaboration agreements, and external project partnerships.
* Implement, maintain, and contribute to the improvement of project\-management frameworks, tools, processes, and practices used to monitor budgets, schedules, resources, risks, milestones, and project performance.
* Organize and facilitate project and team meetings, including schedules, logistics, agendas, presentation materials, decisions, action items, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate with staff and project\-management personnel at other national laboratories and partner organizations to support communication, planning, team organization, resource coordination, milestones, and execution of multi\-laboratory projects and consortia.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the TSS.3 level**

* Conduct complex technical and operational project\-coordination activities under minimal direction, developing approaches, priorities, and solutions necessary to support successful completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* Perform independent technical and operational analyses, synthesize project information, and develop recommendations to inform strategic project decisions involving schedules, budgets, resources, risks, priorities, and execution approaches.
* Analyze and resolve complex project execution issues requiring in\-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creative application of established project\-management, technical, and operational methods.
* Coordinate and prioritize multiple parallel activities involving competing requirements, changing priorities, or less well\-defined assignments, and provide project leadership for defined activities by coordinating contributors and guiding execution toward project objectives.

### **Qualifications**


* This position requires an active DOE Q\-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, project management, business, engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Comprehensive knowledge of project\-management concepts, practices, and tools, with broad experience applying project\-management principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to technical or operational projects.
* Comprehensive experience independent

Overview:

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

  

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

  

The Intelligence Analyst, assigned to a specific client, will monitor open\-source intelligence (OSINT) software and various OSINT sources to proactively identify risks to company's facilities, traveling employees, and vehicle fleets. The Analyst plays a pivotal role in enhancing the client's overall security measures by conducting research, proactively identifying threats, contributing to the development of robust risk management procedures, and assisting with incident management. This role is encouraged to recommend and work towards continuous improvement and proactive measures to uphold the client's commitment to safety. **This is a temporary full\-time position for four months, which may be longer or shorter based on business needs.**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Monitor open\-source intelligence (OSINT) software and a variety of OSINT sources to proactively identify risks to company facilities, traveling employees, and a fleet of company vehicles.
* Conduct research and analysis of identified risks and transmit alerts to key stakeholders.
* Assist Security Dispatchers with day\-to\-day security operations tasks, as needed.
* Receive real\-time alerts and quickly triage disruptions to determine their validity and relevance to the client.
* Collect, evaluate, and disseminate intelligence to key stakeholders in support of action plans based on credibility and likelihood.

jobs.title: Physical Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based consulting firm that delivers experienced field professionals to construction and utility organizations across the state. We partner with contractors, program owners, and utility clients to provide skilled inspection, construction management, and field support personnel who keep infrastructure projects safe, compliant, and on schedule.



Our team understands the demands of active construction environments, from underground gas and electric infrastructure to large\-scale utility programs. By pairing deep industry knowledge with a responsive, hands\-on approach, we help clients maintain quality, meet regulatory requirements, and keep field operations running smoothly on some of California's most critical infrastructure projects.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Physical Security Project Manager  

**Sector:** Physical Security / Construction  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Primary Locations:** Santa Cruz or Santa Clara, CA  

**Travel:** Occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino, CA  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – Office, Field \& Home  

**Contract Length:** 1 Year \+  

**Compensation:** $58\.00 \- $80\.00/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Physical Security Project Manager to lead the planning and field execution of complex physical security and low\-voltage system projects throughout California. This role will oversee projects involving access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, perimeter protection, intercoms, and supporting electrical and low\-voltage infrastructure.



The ideal candidate brings at least seven years of relevant project management experience and a strong field construction background. This position requires someone who can move comfortably between project planning and active job sites, coordinate contractors and technical teams, evaluate installation conditions, manage budgets and schedules, and oversee testing and commissioning while maintaining disciplined project documentation and governance.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Manage physical security and low\-voltage projects from planning and site assessment through installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource requirements, milestones, and project documentation.
* Conduct job walks and site assessments to validate design requirements, installation conditions, constructability, and project risks.
* Coordinate installation of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, intercoms, perimeter security, and supporting infrastructure.
* Manage security integrators, subcontractors, technicians, vendors, and other project resources.
* Coordinate physical security activities with IT, Corporate Security, facilities, construction teams, and business stakeholders.
* Review construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and installation requirements.
* Coordinate procurement of equipment, materials, permits, and other resources necessary for project execution.
* Monitor field activities for safety, workmanship, quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.
* Troubleshoot technical and construction issues and coordinate solutions with installation teams and stakeholders.
* Oversee inspection, functional testing, commissioning, and turnover of installed security systems.
* Maintain accurate project records, including risk and issue logs, change documentation, as\-built information, progress reports, and closeout packages.
* Track project budgets, labor hours, material costs, forecasts, and overall financial performance.
* Identify scope changes and coordinate appropriate change management and change order documentation.
* Provide structured project status reporting to project sponsors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and field constraints and drive mitigation plans through resolution.
* Coordinate final project handoff to operations and support teams.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* 7\+ years of relevant experience managing physical security, low\-voltage, electrical, or closely related field construction projects.
* Direct experience managing field installation projects involving physical security systems.
* Strong knowledge of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, perimeter protection, or related security technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise access control or video management platforms such as AMAG, Software House, Genetec, or comparable systems.
* Strong understanding of low\-voltage construction and installation practices.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and related project documentation.
* Experience managing contractors, security integrators, technicians, vendors, and other field resources.
* Experience conducting site assessments, job walks, inspections, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, risk, change, resources, and project documentation.
* Experience operating within structured PMO processes and maintaining project governance documentation.
* Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel between project locations.
* Ability to work in active construction environments and wear required PPE, including FR clothing, hard hat, safety vest, and appropriate safety footwear.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule across office, field, and home environments.
* Ability to support projects primarily in Santa Cruz and Santa Clara, with occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino.

**You'll Stand Out If You Have**
-------------------------
